asked.item: Is there a field to post as a reply inside an existing Slack thread (thread_ts)

verdict.reason: The Slack sentences list channelId as the only Slack target field and no optional fields, so the documented fields show no thread option.

steps.text: The Slack target lists channelId as its only field, and it has no optional fields.
The Slack page describes publishing text and images to a connected Slack channel using its channelId.
